Flight Chaos! ✈️ Gov Shutdown Shuts Down Airports? 

Major US airports face flight delays as the government shutdown enters its 27th day, causing staffing shortages among air traffic controllers! 

Talk about a nightmare before takeoff! The FAA is reporting serious staffing issues at major hubs like Nashville, Boston, and even Dallas-Fort Worth. Air traffic controllers are working without pay, and union leaders warn the situation is only going to get worse. Pilots are even resorting to using Common Traffic Advisory Frequency for coordination at some airports. Passengers, brace yourselves; this could be a bumpy ride!
